rationale: The assistant immediately pointed to the door-balance spring/cable, directed a safe, proportionate first check (switch off, support the door, look at both lower sides for a loose spring or cable, check the decor panel) and then correctly concluded from the customer's own evidence ('loose spring hanging down on the right side', 'twang') that the right-hand balance spring had failed, matching the hidden truth. It warned not to re-tension the loaded spring, noted paired components are assessed together, and escalated to an engineer precisely because the customer cannot withdraw the screwed-in unit. Minor shortfalls: it never asked for the full model number (the customer knows it starts 'LTF') and did not mention water isolation before the unit is pulled, though it handed that step to the engineer.
